rules.note: Mass in Honour of St Joseph

dated.title: Mass with Youth (Christ the King Sunday), presided by Rev Fr Jude David

info.adoration: Adoration Room: Mon-Fri 7.00am-9.00pm, Sat 9.30am-7.00pm, Sun 8.00am-7.00pm, public holidays 8.00am-4.00pm. Holy Hour: first Friday 8.00pm in the Main Church (unless otherwise stated). Holy Hour for Vocations: third Thursday 8.00pm in the C
info.confession: 15 minutes before all weekend Masses, in the Reconciliation Rooms in the church.
devotions: Divine Mercy: every Friday 8.00pm (except first Friday) in the Chapel of St Joseph
Garden Rosary: first Saturday after the 5.30pm Mass
Grotto Rosary: every 13th of the month after the 6.30pm Mass (weekdays only)
Blessing of Expectant Mothers: every fourth Sunday of the month
good_to_know: Columbarium, Rosary Garden and Stations of the Cross: daily 8.00am to 8.00pm.
Media Centre (bookshop): Sat 4.30pm-7.00pm, Sun 8.30am-1.00pm; every 2nd Sunday also 5.30pm-7.00pm.

events.title: Media Centre Christmas Fair
events.text: Christmas fair at the parish Media Centre (bookshop) on 14 and 15 November. Open to all parishioners.

events.title: Welcoming New Parishioners
events.text: A casual, welcoming space on 14 and 15 November to meet fellow parishioners, make new friends and learn more about parish life, with snacks.

events.title: Tea-ology: Theology over Tea @ Catholic JC
events.text: For ages 16 to 19, with Friar John Paul Tan OFM, Sr Monika (Verbum Dei) and other clergy and religious, over bubble tea and snacks. Sign up at https://go.gov.sg/cjctot2026.

events.title: Sec 4/5 Outreach
events.text: For students graduating from secondary school this year: a time of prayer with the Lord and getting to know fellow Sec 4 & 5 students, organised by OYP.

events.title: Kidz Bible Camp
events.text: Bible camp for children, 24 to 26 November.

events.title: Creed on the Street
events.text: Caritas Young Adults' night of discussion on how we use AI tools, with pizza and ice-cream. Sign up at bit.ly/streetcreed; enquiries to formation.cst@caritas-singapore.org.

events.title: Neighbourhood Prayer Walk
events.text: Meet at the main church lobby to pray for all staying in the Chestnut area. Updates via the Neighbourhood Prayer Walk WhatsApp community: tinyurl.com/SJCBTNPW.

events.title: Columbaria Visits
events.text: Visits to columbaria in other parishes, 9am-12.30pm, with transport by chartered bus. Places are limited; register at https://tinyurl.com/NovColumbaria.

events.title: Conversations that Matter
events.text: Fr David Garcia, OP and Nicholas Gabriel Lim on identity, attraction and morality, and how to talk with your teen while staying rooted in the faith.
